data.description:
A NIGHTMARE ON MAIN STREET

We're celebrating local DJ extraordinaire Alex Rivera's 28th Bday in style ya'll, with a VERY special guest bringin that LA global flavor, SpydaT.E.K, to lay down some enlightenment in the 412 and kick off this massive Halloween weekend at Cobra in pure bordertown styleeee.

DJ Yamez and KEEB$ are also on the docket to round out what will be nothing short of a banger of a Costume Party!

$15 Limited Presale
$20 Door
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SpydaT.E.K - 

As curator of Pitbull's Globalization and host of his own syndicated show on 96.1 The Beat, DJ, Producer, Remixer, & On-Air Mixer, SpydaT.E.K. is an all-around bass music chameleon. His music has been gaining the respect and attention it rightfully deserves while continuing to separate himself from the pack releasing a steady stream of original productions and remixes ranging from Trap-influenced 808 slappers to soulful dance cuts, and Latin-fused club bangers that grab even the most commercially influenced music listener.  SpydaT.E.K's recent run of Cumbia edits have been clogging the sound waves from LA to Austin, the 305 and back to NYC with his recent Wu Baile cuts....pure fire.

His track, "Duro Bass" was released on Diplo's Mad Decent label supported by Major Lazer, Ookay, Annie Nightingale, & many more. His other productions have been officially supported by the likes of Diplo, Major Lazer, DJ Snake, Anna Lunoe, DJ Craze, GTA, Alison Wonderland, Branchez, & more.

After over a decade of regularly booking renowned dance music artists from Toy Selectah to Uproot Andy, we are very excited to host this talented DJ and producer.
